label: Move File
description: Move a file from a source path to a destination path within the WordPress installation. Both paths must remain inside ABSPATH. Default refuses overwrite; pass overwrite:true to replace an existing destination. Refuses when either source or destination resolves to wp-config.php or .htaccess.

source.description: Source file path relative to ABSPATH. Must exist.

destination.description: Destination file path relative to ABSPATH.

overwrite.description: When true, an existing destination file is replaced. Even with overwrite:true, wp-config.php and .htaccess are refused.

guards: realpath(source) and realpath(destination-parent) must resolve inside realpath(ABSPATH)
source must exist and be a file (not a directory)
source basename must not be wp-config.php or .htaccess when source resolves at ABSPATH root
destination basename must not be wp-config.php or .htaccess when destination resolves at ABSPATH root
